findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no soap to be available at bar hand sink. Discussed with PIC, soap was brought to hand sink. Ensure hand sinks are properly supplied with soap to prevent ay possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed a container of pizza sauce to be held past its 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, sauce was from an old system facility was using. Sauce was discarded and education was provided on date marking policy. Ensure any TCS item kept longer and 7 days is discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed 2 chemical spray bottles to be resting on the same shelf as drinks behind the bar. Discussed with PIC, bottles were relocated to an approved location. Ensure all chemicals are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 7-201.11 Separation. Poisonous or toxic materials shall be stored so they can not contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles by: (A) Separating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS by spacing or partitioning; and (B) Locating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS in an area that is not above FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE or SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed ice scoop to be resting on the top of ice machine with a thin layer of dust present. Discussed with PIC, ice scoop was put through the wash, rinse, sanitizer process and placed in a clean container. Ensure in use utensils are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(E) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(E) In a clean, protected location if the utensils, such as ice scoops, are used only with a food that is not time/temperature control for safety food.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be set at the bar upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was prepared and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a chemicals sanitizer solution is prepared and available at both the bar and kitchen during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.
